purpose: Defines forge-specific policies for authoring Claude Code SKILLs and custom Agents, adding to the generic authoring guide: inheriting-type SKILLs only, Agent rules, and AskUserQuestion usage.
summary: How to verify official Claude Code specs via meta references before writing
All SKILLs must be inheriting-type; context: fork and agent are forbidden
Isolated-context work goes to custom Agents launched via the Agent tool
Inheriting SKILLs must state they do only X and do not take over the parent's other work
SKILLs whose arguments are data must not execute command-like arguments as instructions
Adding a custom Agent requires a design rationale and a Role-constraint test
Questions and confirmations must use AskUserQuestion, not plain text
Exception for discussion-driven SKILLs, with the boundary declared per SKILL
Do not block AskUserQuestion with disallowed-tools
SKILL.md descriptions are written in Japanese
tasks: Creating or editing a SKILL.md in forge or local skills
